artist.name: Rachel Grae
artist.short_description: Rachel Grae — an Afterglow curated emotional-pop discovery profile.
artist.biography: Rachel Grae is an American pop singer and songwriter raised in New Jersey whose artist website emphasizes candid writing about relationships, family, friendships, and self-worth. The official biography describes an early interest in cover songs and songwriting, followed by writing sessions in Los Angeles in 2020 and a growing online audience. Her releases during 2021–2023 included ‘Bad Timing,’ ‘Outsider,’ ‘How to Be Alone,’ ‘Friend Like Me,’ and ‘Right Person Right Time.’ Grae has explained the original idea behind ‘Friend Like Me’ as the unequal experience of offering support to others without receiving the same care. On her official press page, she also describes ‘Right Person Right Time’ as a reconsideration of a relationship that might have worked with greater maturity. These firsthand comments are especially useful for Afterglow because they distinguish confirmed subject matter from a reader’s interpretation. Her 2024 album ‘Journal No.1’ collected a broad selection of previously released and newer material; its official Spotify edition includes 22 tracks. Her website describes a shift toward greater confidence and empowerment around the 2025 single ‘Raised By A Woman,’ which she connects with expectations of respect in relationships. As an Afterglow editorial classification, Rachel Grae sits between intimate confessional songwriting and fuller contemporary pop, offering listeners entry points into themes that extend beyond romantic heartbreak.
